prime_aboleth_lesser_recipe.name: Aboleth Mucus-Glaze Roast

prime_gibbering_mouther_recipe.name: Mouther's Babbling Galantine
prime_gibbering_mouther_recipe.description: A galantine rolled from the multi-mouthed mass, every mouth still trying to speak as you slice. The fluids run a different color from each. Pour them off.

prime_intellect_devourer_recipe.name: Brain-Walker Tartine

prime_nothic_recipe.name: Nothic Cyclops-Eye Confit
prime_nothic_recipe.description: The single great eye, slow-cooked in its own fat with the wizard-curse still humming inside. Tastes of forbidden knowledge and faint regret.

0.desc: Ruined — the eye rotted in place and the secret it knew was the cook's

prime_grell_recipe.name: Grell Tentacle Pickle
prime_grell_recipe.description: Ten paralytic tentacles pickled in brine, the beak presented as the centerpiece. The pickle stings and steadies in roughly equal measure.

0.desc: Ruined — the pickle paralyzed the cook for half a watch

prime_cloaker_recipe.name: Cloaker Black-Cape Wrap
prime_cloaker_recipe.description: The smothering creature, rolled into its own folded cape and steamed gently until the moaning stops. Open the wrap with care: the teeth are still inside.

1.desc: Loose fold; the moan still leaks out

prime_marilith_spawn_recipe.name: Six-Arm Snake Curry

prime_vrock_recipe.name: Stone-Vulture Confit

prime_hezrou_recipe.name: Toad-Demon Croquettes
